personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with Editorial Structure
personality_one_liner: Recruiter-side AI talent intelligence command center combining rigorous deterministic matching with grounded evidence scoring in an obsidian and signal-green workspace.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing rhythm with compact data-dense cards and strict 8pt grid alignment.

do's: Use frosted glass header bar and sticky bottom action containers over scrolling talent lists
Apply translucent tint over dark architectural backdrop for hero summaries
dont's: Do not blur dense candidate detail tables or requirement matrix data
Do not use glass on form inputs

screens.name: Auth / Demo Entry
screens.purpose: Secure authentication with Emergent Google auth and immediate 1-tap recruiter demo access.
screens.layout: Immersive dark architectural backdrop with glass login card, demo instant access button, and Google Auth integration.

screens.name: Overview
screens.purpose: Recruiter intelligence command center displaying active job pipelines, recent candidate screenings, and system health.

states.empty: No jobs or pipelines created yet. Create your first job JD.
states.error: Failed to sync recruitment telemetry. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical dashboard with top metrics summary, active priority job card, recent top matches, and quick screening upload trigger.

screens.name: Jobs
screens.purpose: Manage open JDs, trigger JD extraction with LLM, and upload candidate resume batches.

states.loading: Parsing job descriptions and candidate pools...
states.empty: No open job descriptions found. Upload a JD to begin smart ranking.
states.error: Failed to retrieve job listings. Retry.

screens.layout: Tabbed or searchable list of roles with department badges, candidate counts, deterministic weight toggles, and new JD creation flow.

screens.name: Rankings
screens.purpose: Explore the 18-candidate seeded dataset ranked via hybrid keyword + semantic + evidence scoring with top-three highlighting.

states.loading: Running hybrid vector and keyword matching engines...
states.empty: No candidates scored for this role yet. Upload resumes to populate ranking.
states.error: Scoring engine timeout. Tap to refresh.

screens.layout: Filtered candidate rank list with top-3 podium badges, score breakdown bars, evidence confidence chips, and compare triggers.

screens.name: Candidate Detail
screens.purpose: Deep inspect candidate match evidence, claimed-vs-demonstrated skills, and requirements matrix.

states.loading: Extracting candidate telemetry and evidence snippets...
states.error: Failed to load candidate verification file. Retry.

screens.layout: Stacked sheet with candidate header score, radar/progress metrics, requirement verification matrix, and grounded AI interview prompts.

screens.name: Compare
screens.purpose: Side-by-side comparative analysis of selected candidates across critical job requirements and evidence scores.

states.empty: Select at least two candidates to compare side by side.

screens.layout: Scrollable side-by-side comparison columns highlighting score deltas, skill overlap, and AI recommendation rationale.

screens.name: Recruiter AI
screens.purpose: Grounded AI assistant answering recruiter queries against indexed resume evidence and job requirements.

states.empty: Ask anything about your candidate pool, e.g., 'Who has direct Kafka experience?'
states.error: AI service unavailable. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Chat interface with grounded citation cards, suggested prompt pills, and secure evidence-backed response streams.

screens.name: JD Insights & Technical View
screens.purpose: Inspect JD skill weight breakdown, deterministic scoring algorithm telemetry, and future student intelligence architecture beta.

states.loading: Calculating matching algorithm weights and telemetry...

screens.layout: Modular technical telemetry display with hybrid weight sliders, score distribution chart, and beta student intelligence toggle.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure recruiter profile, LLM extraction keys, deterministic weight defaults, and team permissions.
screens.layout: Clean settings list with account info, API integrations, haptic feedback toggles, and data export options.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app fully implements the recruiter-side Smart Shortlisting Engine with 18 seeded candidates, hybrid keyword + semantic matching, evidence-weighted breakdown, compare mode, grounded recruiter AI, and real/demo authentication. Follow all spacing, token, and dark-first utility guidelines. No emojis in system UI.
